description: Rank trading partners for a reporter by trade value for a given commodity and flow direction. Returns the top N partners sorted by descending value — answers "who does country X mainly export product Y to?" or "where does country X mainly import product Z from?" for a single period. Fetches a disaggregated breakdown across all partners then sorts locally. Takes an HS or SITC code in the selected classification; omit cmd_code to rank partners for total trade.

classification.description: Goods classification: HS as reported, H0–H6 with authenticated access, or SITC S1–S4/SS.

cmd_code.description: Single goods code in the selected classification: HS (e.g. "84", "8471") or SITC (e.g. "071"). Omit or pass "TOTAL" to rank partners for total merchandise trade.

limit.description: Number of top partners to return; totalPartners counts every partner retrieved.

period.description: Single period: annual YYYY or monthly YYYYMM, month 01–12; frequency is inferred.

reporter_code.description: M49 numeric code of the reporting country (0–999).

name: comtrade_get_top_partners

classification.description: Goods classification the commodity code was read in.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `keyless_hs_edition_unsupported`: An explicit HS edition H0–H6 requires authenticated access. `invalid_reporter_filter`: Reporter omission lacks an explicit partner. `upstream_validation`: UN Comtrade rejects the query dimensions. `invalid_upstream_response`: UN Comtrade returns malformed trade data. `rate_limited`: UN Comtrade rate-limited the ranking request through its retries. `deadline_exceeded`: The ranking request did not complete within the call's time budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Recovery hint when no data is returned.

partners.description: Top partners sorted by descending trade value.

items.description: A single ranked trading partner entry.

primaryValueUsd.description: Trade value in USD (FOB for exports, CIF for imports).

sharePercent.description: Share of totalValueUsd across every retrieved partner, as a percentage.

referenceNotice.description: Reference descriptions unavailable; codes and values retained.

totalPartners.description: Partners retrieved before the limit, excluding the World (0) aggregate.

totalValueUsd.description: Sum of primary values across all returned partners (before limit truncation).

truncated.description: True when API returned 500 records and results may be incomplete.

title: Get Top Trading Partners
